Strategy: Shift the sweet band upward to residuals between thirty-five and fifty while keeping the mid penalty, testing whether slightly roomier leftovers work better. This combination beat Best Fit on another seed, but the shifted band may not transfer and may match fewer real item sizes.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 35 and r - item <= 50 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
